provenance: Original synthetic SeatLayer evaluation layouts; no customer or real-venue source data.

supersedes.note: Version 1.0.0 remains published unchanged and is the chart the 14 September 2026 arena benchmark measured. Version 2.0.0 changes captions only: the event-floor caption moved out of the centre onto a floor panel west of the stage, and the centre-stage caption ink was darkened. Seats, sections, rows and zones are identical.

limitations: Synthetic evaluation fixtures, not reconstructions of real venues.
Do not use for physical capacity, dimensions, sightlines, accessibility routes, egress, safety, or regulatory compliance.
